title: AI Product Videos for Home Brands | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one home product photo into a room scene, a cleaning demo, or an organizing clip. Download files with no watermark for listings, feeds, and paid ads.
h1: AI Product Videos for Home Brands, Shown in the Room They Fit
lead: Home shoppers need the product in a room, doing one job. Paste a product link or one clear photo and get that scene. You do not need to build a styled room. Credits are what each job spends.
card: Room scenes, cleaning demos, and organizing moments from one home product photo.

faq.q: Can I show a before-and-after of a closet?
faq.a: Yes, if the after state is something your product really does. Describe both states in plain words, and do not show a result the product cannot produce.

faq.q: Will furniture look the right size?
faq.a: Put the real dimensions on the listing. You can name a size in the scene, such as a 24-inch round side table beside an armchair. The pictured size can still be off.

faq.q: Does this work for sofas and beds?
faq.a: It can, when the photo shows the whole piece, including the legs. Name a room large enough to hold it. If a part is missing from the photo, such as a leg or a handle, the result cannot add it.

faq.q: Can I start from a white-background photo?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the whole product in the picture, including legs, handles, and cords. The scene can only use what the photo shows.

faq.q: Can I make a short cleaning demo?
faq.a: Yes. Show one mess you can see, keep the camera steady, and show the product making a single pass. A 10-second clip spends 40 credits.

faq.q: What should I name in the scene?
faq.a: Name the room, nearby furniture, the light, and the one action shoppers need. Keep exact dimensions and materials in the listing.

faq.q: Can I run the clips as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark, so no logo is stamped on the file. You can use them in paid ads. Keep the size, and how much it holds, true to the item.

faq.q: Do I need a studio or a model?
faq.a: You do not need a studio, and you do not hire anyone. Pick a person the tool creates. A clip can include a spoken line and captions. A 6-second clip spends 24 credits, 15 seconds spends 60, and 30 seconds spends 120. If it fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link and make more than one version?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page, or send that link from your own shop software (the API). Ask for a short script and pick a person the tool creates. Make a few versions, including one in another language. Trim the clip in the editor on this page. Choose a voice and a music track, and check the captions. Then send it to TikTok, Facebook, or Instagram. Put the real size in the listing, because the pictured size can be off.
